nodes.text:
Advisory for Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV):
It is a common respiratory virus that causes upper and lower respiratory infections, similar to a cold or flu. It's particularly more severe in young children, the elderly, and those with weakened immune systems. #hmpvvirus #HMPVoutbreak

nodes.author: dkpaliwal18
nodes.text: Symptoms: Common symptoms include cough, fever, nasal congestion, and shortness of breath. Severe cases can lead to bronchitis or pneumonia.

nodes.author: dkpaliwal18
nodes.text: Preventive Measures: Hygiene: Regular hand washing with soap, avoiding touching your face with unwashed hands, and maintaining good respiratory hygiene (covering mouth and nose when coughing or sneezing).

nodes.author: dkpaliwal18
nodes.text:
Avoid Contact: Try to avoid close contact with people who are sick. If you are sick, stay home to prevent spreading the virus.
Public Health: Avoid crowded places, especially during peak respiratory illness seasons.

nodes.author: dkpaliwal18
nodes.text: If you or someone you know shows severe symptoms like difficulty breathing, seek medical attention immediately. For general cases, symptomatic treatment at home is usually adequate.
